source_context: Panel 1 of a 4-panel method figure: 'Dependence'. A 14x14 symmetric mutual-information matrix D of a toy 14-gene dataset (blue sequential scale, light = low MI, dark = high MI; grey diagonal = self). Gene i (row 4) is a horizontal blue band, gene j (column 5) is a vertical pink band, crossing at the traced cell outlined in black, D_ij = MI(i, j) = 0.31. The matrix has a dark chain block around genes 4-9 and a second moderate block around genes 10-13. Caption below the matrix: D_ij = MI(i, j) = 0.31. Header chip: numbered black circle 1, bold title 'Dependence', grey tag 'query-key score' with a blue left edge.
